name: Romancin Dudes
source:
[i]"I'm sorry, you're just not edgy enough for me."[/i]

Those are the words I hear as I get rejected for the twenty eighth time this year…

Bobka Smith is an otome game heroine. Or, at least, she was supposed to be. A week before production went underway, and she was booted from the cast for being "too stereotypical." She was sent to School, an extremely generic high school filled with students like her. Bobka, however, is determined to carry out her destiny and have her perfect otome ending, no matter what the cost.

Unfortunately nobody at School seems interested, and after years of [s]stalking[/s] romantic pursuits, she's been shot down by practically every member of the student body. There have got to still be options left though, right? Help Bobka quell the passionate burning in her heart before she graduates from School, and on the way realize that people don't tend to fit perfectly into the molds that they're given.

[From [url=https://edelblu.itch.io/romancin-dudes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]“对不起，你还不够离经叛道，不是我的菜。”[/i]

这是我今年第28次被拒绝时听到的话…

博布卡·史密斯是个乙女游戏女主角。至少，她本该是的。离制作开始只剩一个星期，她却因为“太套路”被踢出了演员阵容。她被送进了一所名叫“学校”的高中，学校普通得不能再普通，学生也都跟她是一路人。但博布卡已经下定决心，不惜一切代价要完成自己的使命，迎来完美的乙女游戏结局。

可惜，“学校”里似乎没人对她感兴趣。这些年来，经过一番[s]跟踪骚扰[/s]浪漫追求，几乎全校学生都拒绝过她。可总该还有人能选吧？帮博布卡在毕业前平息心头这团爱火吧。在此过程中，她也会慢慢明白，人很少能严丝合缝地嵌进别人给他们套上的模子。

［摘自[url=https://edelblu.itch.io/romancin-dudes]Itch.io[/url]］
